The '''''Counterpunch''''' was a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruiser]] that operated in [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Group Three (Zsinj)|third group]].<ref name="AllstonWebsite">{{WebCite|url=http://www.aaronallston.com/factpages/faq_starwars.html|text=(Aaron Allston's Web Site) FAQ: Star Wars Novels|author=Aaron Allston|date=2013-01-15|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20150102092638/http://www.aaronallston.com/factpages/faq_starwars.html Aaron Allston's Web Site]|archivedate=20150102092638}}</ref>

Together with the rest of Group Three, the Counterpunch [[Battle of Levian Two|arrived]] at [[Levian Two]] in order to reinforce Zsinj's [[Group One (Zsinj)|Group One]] and [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|Iron Fist]] against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Solo's]] [[Solo Fleet|fleet]].

Later the ship temporarily detached from its group and, in a daring operation, the ''Counterpunch'' was destroyed by [[Vispil]]ian security forces when the leaders of Vispil refused Zsinj's bribes and denied him use of their facilities.

==Behind the scenes==
The Counterpunch first appears in [[Aaron Allston|Aaron Allston's]] X-Wing: Solo Command but is only identified as a Carrack-class light cruiser through an FAQ entry on the authors website, which also places the ship in Group Three of Zsinj's fleet, thereby identifying it as the same ship present at Levian Two.<ref name="AllstonWebsite"/>
